fields.Name: T198 - Search No Results Handling
fields.Description: Verifies that searching a nonsense term in a grid quick-filter (or global search) produces a clean 'no results' / 'No Matching Rows' state without any error.

InputDefinition.goal: After logging in, open an AssociationDemo entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Events', then click the exact 'Events' node (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Once the grid loads, type the nonsense term 'zzqxnomatch' into the grid quick-filter box ('Filter records...'). Verify the grid responds with a clean empty/'no results'/'No Matching Rows' state - no rows match and no error is shown. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A grid (or global search) was searched with the nonsense term 'zzqxnomatch'
A clean 'no results' / 'No Matching Rows' empty-state is displayed with no matching rows
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
